description: This file defines the CustomerOptionService interface, which extends a generic service interface for managing CustomerOption entities. It declares methods for listing options by store and language, saving or updating options, and retrieving options by a specific code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionService
classes.description: An interface for customer option related operations extending a generic service interface.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOption objects associated with a specific MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Registers a new CustomerOption or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a CustomerOption based on store and option code.
